brief: Customized shampoo and conditioner built from a quiz - hair type, goals, scent. Subscription refills every 2 months. Looking for people who haven't found the right hair routine.

profile.business_summary: Customized shampoo and conditioner subscription service where products are tailored to the customer's hair type, goals, and scent preferences via an onboarding quiz. Refills are delivered automatically every 2 months.
stated_claims: Customized shampoo and conditioner built from a quiz - hair type, goals, scent.

relevant_tags.why: This is the core product category (shampoo and conditioner).
The products are customized for each individual based on a quiz.
Haircare is a major subcategory of beauty.
The business model relies on recurring 2-month refills.
Shampoo and conditioner are primary bath and shower products.
Adjacent self-care/routine category with highly overlapping shopper interest.

persona_conflicts.evidence: built from a quiz - hair type, goals, scent

note_signals.why: Direct competitor in personalized haircare; will likely block this advertiser.

profile.gate_reason: The product, customization mechanism, and subscription model are clearly defined, allowing for immediate campaign planning.
clarifying_questions: What is the price point for the initial customized set and the bi-monthly refills?

pricing.rationale: Pay per click (verifiable without trusting a pixel). Market price to win a page view on these hosts: $0.65-$0.86 per click (median $0.74), from the simulated auction against the other campaigns. 'balanced' bidding tries to win up to 60% of each host's page views; the planned bid per host is the price that wins its planned share.
pricing.tcpa_unlock: tCPA unlocks after conversion tracking is verified and 50 click-through conversions are recorded.

allocations.rationale: market price $0.63-$0.85 (median $0.71); bidding $0.47 wins ~2% of page views, paying ~$0.45 per click (second price)
market price $0.65-$0.86 (median $0.74); bidding $0.47 wins ~4% of page views, paying ~$0.43 per click (second price); host also sells this kind of product: confirm it allows competing brands
